Package com.agrialert.ui.fields.groups

Class GroupFieldUiModel

java.lang.Object
com.agrialert.ui.fields.groups.GroupFieldUiModel
public class GroupFieldUiModel extends Object
UI Model representing a field within the context of group management. This model holds the information necessary to display a field in a selection list, including its association with a group and its selection state.
